<p class="eyebrow">Transport · source definitions · calendar comparisons</p>
<h1>Freight &amp; Trade Research</h1>
<p class="intro">Read US transport activity at its original precision. Follow each measurement to its monthly observation, source unit, comparison dates and published evidence.</p>
<section class="note" aria-labelledby="freight-limits"><h2 id="freight-limits">Descriptive research · no position instruction</h2><p>Rail, trucking, Cass and TSI overlap and publish on different calendars. Their agreement does not establish independent evidence or a leading GDP signal. Source reproducibility does not establish forecast accuracy.</p><p>The original Freight Pulse acquisition remains scheduled at <strong>11:50 UTC daily</strong>. A new publication can contain older monthly observations; publication age does not certify observation freshness.</p></section>
<p id="freight-status" class="timestamp" role="status">Reading complete freight packet…</p>
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="freight-series-title"><h2 id="freight-series-title">Monthly source measurements</h2><p id="freight-count" class="muted">Waiting for the reviewed monthly contract.</p><div id="freight-series" class="table-region" role="region" aria-label="All monthly freight series" tabindex="0"></div><p>Year-over-year and six-month changes require those exact calendar months. Missing months remain unavailable. Six-month growth is annualized only for seasonally adjusted (SA) series; non-seasonally adjusted (NSA) Cass indexes remain unannualized.</p><p id="freight-ratio">Cass index ratio unavailable.</p></section>
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="freight-observations-title"><h2 id="freight-observations-title">Inspect every monthly observation</h2><label>Source series<select id="freight-choice"></select></label><p id="freight-definition" class="timestamp">Source definitions and metadata clocks appear here.</p><p id="freight-observation-count" class="muted">Waiting for complete monthly observations.</p><div id="freight-observations" class="table-region" role="region" aria-label="All observations for the selected source" tabindex="0"></div><div class="pager"><button id="freight-prev" type="button" disabled>Previous observations</button><button id="freight-next" type="button" disabled>Next observations</button></div><p>The z-score describes distance from the prior 60 exact monthly observations, excluding the current month. It is not a probability, forecast, or crisis threshold. A month-start label represents a month, not its release date.</p><div class="links"><a href="https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/TSIFRGHT">TSI definition</a><a href="https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/FRGSHPUSM649NCIS">Cass shipments</a><a href="https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/FRGEXPUSM649NCIS">Cass expenditures</a><a href="https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/TRUCKD11">Trucking</a><a href="https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/RAILFRTCARLOADSD11">Rail carloads</a><a href="https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/RAILFRTINTERMODALD11">Rail intermodal</a></div></section>
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="freight-evidence-title"><h2 id="freight-evidence-title">Freight evidence and inherited calculations</h2><p id="freight-preservation">Reading preservation status…</p><div class="links"><a href="/data/freight-pulse.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">Complete freight JSON</a><a href="/data/ops/releases/justhodl-freight-pulse.json">Deployed code receipt</a><a href="/engine-data.html?page=freight-pulse.html">All engine data</a></div><details id="freight-details"><summary>Inspect every freight field and original value</summary><p>Legacy composite scores, inflections, positional growth and beta impacts remain inspectable without becoming qualified forecasts. The weekly EIA distillate block remains pending a separate source/calendar review; petroleum product supplied is not direct truck fuel consumption.</p><pre id="freight-original">Open to inspect the complete packet.</pre></details></section>
<h2>Related evidence, separate definitions</h2><p>No missing source is interpreted as agreement. These packets remain independently accessible while their definitions and native publication clocks are reviewed.</p>
<div class="research-links">
<section class="card"><h3>Air cargo</h3><p>HKIA cargo weight is not cargo value, a semiconductor breakdown, or a global air-cargo census. Workbook, monthly ledger and revision validation remain separate work.</p><p id="air-status" class="timestamp" role="status">Reading air packet…</p><a href="/data/air-cargo.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">Complete air-cargo JSON</a><details id="air-details"><summary>Inspect every air-cargo field</summary><pre id="air-original">Open to inspect the complete packet.</pre></details></section>
<section class="card"><h3>Transport price and trade sources</h3><p>The inherited rate-pressure composite mixes differently defined series. Source-specific units, dates and forecast meaning are not yet qualified; its score and scraped Baltic Dry claims are not used here.</p><p id="trade-status" class="timestamp" role="status">Reading trade packet…</p><a href="/data/trade-nowcast.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">Complete trade JSON</a><details id="trade-details"><summary>Inspect every trade-source field</summary><pre id="trade-original">Open to inspect the complete packet.</pre></details></section>
<section class="card"><h3>Industry value and volume</h3><p>Inspect each price index and physical shipment comparison in the dedicated research view. Different units and covered-port populations cannot be combined into an automatic industry-cycle call.</p><p id="boom-status" class="timestamp" role="status">Reading industry packet…</p><a href="/boom-stage.html">Open industry research</a><details id="boom-details"><summary>Inspect every industry packet field</summary><pre id="boom-original">Open to inspect the complete packet.</pre></details></section>
<section class="card"><h3>Shipping calls and estimated weights</h3><p>Vessel calls and estimated cargo weights are separate measurements. Neither measures customs trade values or company revenue. Geographic coverage and exact dates are shown on their research pages.</p><p id="shipping-status" class="timestamp" role="status">Reading vessel-call packet…</p><div class="links"><a href="/portwatch.html">Vessel-call research</a><a href="/port-cargo.html">Cargo-weight research</a></div><details id="shipping-details"><summary>Inspect every vessel-call field</summary><pre id="shipping-original">Open to inspect the complete packet.</pre></details></section>
